# Supertext SDK (bundled copy)

Built JavaScript of the TypeScript part of the [Supertext SDK](https://github.com/Supertext/Supertext-API-SDK-and-Guide) (`sdk/typescript`), version 0.4.0, commit `6aaad33eb11d3114d78b3f87d5032398894c7908`. `package.json` only marks the files as ES modules.

Don't edit these files: fix the SDK in its own repository, then run `scripts/vendor-sdk.sh`.
